title: Example Patch - Replace With Your Discord Copy
raw:
**Added**
- New Patchnotes page - copy a Discord message into patches.json to publish
- Hotlink added next to Rusty Stats on main page

**How to update**
- Copy your Discord announcement message
- Paste it as the `raw` field of a new entry at the TOP of this file
- Set `date` to YYYY-MM-DD and `title` to a short summary
- Save and deploy - no HTML editing needed

> Tip: **bold**, *italic*, __underline__, ~~strike~~, `code`, ```code block```, > quote, and - lists all render automatically.
